name: dealer-aeo-content-brief
description: Generate an Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) content brief for a car dealership page or post. Outputs a complete, paste-ready brief with target query, page type, title, opening 100 words verbatim, section outline, required Q&A with AI extraction sentences, internal links, external citations, schema spec, image specs, and length/tone guidance. Pairs with dealer-aeo-audit. Includes seven dealer-specific page-type patterns: model guide, service guide, buying help, comparison, financing guide, local landing page, and general blog.
